title: fenwick marsh q3 2026 工作负载跟踪器
instruction:
您是协调 Fenwick Marsh Environmental 的 Rhiannon Setterfield 的 Q3 2026 许可组合的项目管理专家。 Rhiannon 必须在周五（26 6 月 2026）之前与 Saltcombe Provisions 和 Westmere Logistics 确认客户线索，她需要一个配备人员的季度，而不是另一个临时产能清单。随附的`q3_permitting_workload.xlsx`包含九项可交付成果、活动工作量、依赖性、交付窗口、顾问可用性、能力和批准记录、开发承诺以及适用于155月2026的英格兰许可控制说明。它还包含投资组合团队使用的报告术语。将列出的每周产能视为其他承诺工作后剩余的时间；我们不会增加人员或将工作转移到季度之外。准备 `q3_workload_tracker.xlsx` 并使用该文件名将其写入工作目录的顶层。
工作簿需要让 Rhiannon 和合规审核员建立以下内容，而无需重构您的推理：(1) 为每个可交付成果提供一个负责任的所有者，确定任何支持顾问和批准的提交签署人（如果适用），并按可交付成果和周显示每个人的可用时间分配； (2) 在Q3工作周内安排列出的每项活动，尊重其交付窗口、持续时间、依赖性、能力要求、不可用时段以及任何不能共享一周的活动，并在25九月2026周五之前完成最终组合； (3) 在源代码中应用面向客户的提交和独立审查控制，包括对谁可以签名的限制，但不要将签名状态视为谁可以拥有底层作品的笼统规则； (4) 明确处理 Casimir Oyelowo 的监督提交批准窗口，同时保持最终计划的可行性和适当的监督； (5) 包括一份顾问摘要，显示每周计划时间、可用时间、利用率、剩余容量或超载以及季度总计，以及与详细时间表一致的可交付摘要； (6) 根据能力、相关经验、可用性、客户连续性或记录的发展证据，为每个责任所有者的选择提供简明的、针对具体人员的理由。
来源，并简要记录为什么在可以合理质疑该选择的情况下没有选择另一位看似合理的候选人； (7) 包括您所做的任何保守解释的简短假设和决策日志，而无需发明批准、能力、额外能力或对英格兰控制说明的更改。保持计算实时进行，而不是输入汇总总计，使详细的计划可过滤，并针对超载、未满足的依赖性、缺少签名覆盖范围、在允许的窗口之外工作或禁止的同周组合提供可见的警告。最终工作簿应包含清晰的任务登记册、活动级别的每周计划、顾问和可交付成果摘要以及假设和决策记录。它将在屏幕上读取并导出为季度监督包，因此标签、日期、百分比、图例和警告状态必须保持清晰且明确，而不依赖于隐藏单元或未记录的颜色含义。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/q3_permitting_workload.xlsx` — 提供九个 Q3 允许的可交付成果、活动工作量和依赖性、交付窗口、顾问能力和可用性、能力和签字记录、开发承诺、互斥活动规则、截至 15 5 月 2026 的适用英格兰控制说明以及 Fenwick Marsh 报告术语。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `q3_workload_tracker.xlsx` — 监管就绪的 Q3 资源和工作负载分配跟踪器，涵盖责任所有权、活动调度、每周分配、容量、提交控制、选择理由和决策假设。 （必须完全使用q3_workload_tracker.xlsx在工作目录的顶层创建。；必须涵盖截至25九月2026结束的季度的所有九个提供的可交付成果和所有提供的活动。；必须包括作业登记册、活动级每周计划、顾问和可交付成果摘要以及假设和决策记录。；摘要计算和警告状态必须在工作簿中保持实时和可审计。；详细记录必须是可过滤的，并且在屏幕上查看或导出时，所有可见内容必须保持清晰。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

criteria.description: 提交的 XLSX 作为有效工作簿成功打开，填充的规划区域中没有损坏的部分，也没有可见的电子表格错误。
criteria.evidence: 提交的工作簿结构、公式和显示的单元格值。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准电子表格引擎打开并重新计算工作簿；检查填充的单元格是否有 #REF!、#VALUE!、#DIV/0!、#NAME? 或类似错误。

original.criterion: The submitted XLSX opens successfully as a valid workbook, with no corrupt parts and no visible spreadsheet errors in the populated planning area.
original.evidence: Submitted workbook structure, formulas, and displayed cell values.
original.grader_hint: Open and recalculate the workbook with a standard spreadsheet engine; inspect populated cells for #REF!, #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, #NAME?, or equivalent errors.

criteria.description: 该工作簿提供了任务登记册、活动级别每周计划、顾问和可交付成果摘要以及假设或决策的可识别视图。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿视图、表格或明确标记的区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 视图可以是单独的工作表或明显分离的区域，但每个请求的功能必须易于发现。

original.criterion: The workbook provides identifiable views for the assignment register, activity-level weekly schedule, consultant and deliverable summaries, and assumptions or decisions.
original.evidence: Workbook views, tables, or clearly labelled regions.
original.grader_hint: The views may be separate worksheets or clearly separated regions, but each requested function must be readily discoverable.

criteria.description: 九个源可交付成果中的每一个都作为负责任的分配出现一次，并且只有一个负责任的所有者。
criteria.evidence: 分配寄存器与源可交付标识符进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 匹配源可交付成果 ID，而不仅仅是相似的标题；拒绝遗漏、重复或多个责任所有者。

original.criterion: Each of the nine source deliverables appears exactly once as an accountable assignment and has exactly one accountable owner.
original.evidence: Assignment register compared with the source deliverable identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Match on the source deliverable ID, not merely similar titles; reject omissions, duplicates, or multiple accountable owners.

criteria.description: 每个所有者、活动受托人、支持顾问、审阅者和签字人均从六人来源名册中选出，并且仅在来源允许的角色中使用。
criteria.evidence: 分配登记册和详细时间表中的所有人员字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据名册检查姓名和角色权限；如果不需要支持，则可以接受空白可选支持字段。

original.criterion: Every owner, activity assignee, supporting consultant, reviewer, and signatory is drawn from the six-person source roster and is used only in a role the source permits.
original.evidence: All personnel fields in the assignment register and detailed schedule.
original.grader_hint: Check names and role permissions against the roster; blank optional support fields are acceptable where support is not required.

criteria.description: 每个所需的源活动都被精确地安排一次，其全部规定的工作量都被考虑并链接到正确的可交付成果。
criteria.evidence: 详细的活动时间表和源活动记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较活动 ID 和所需的工作量。仅当源将活动标记为可拆分时，拆分工作量才是可接受的，并且拆分行的总和必须精确等于所需的小时数。

original.criterion: Every required source activity is scheduled exactly once, with its full stipulated effort accounted for and linked to the correct deliverable.
original.evidence: Detailed activity schedule and source activity records.
original.grader_hint: Compare activity IDs and required effort. Split effort is acceptable only where the source marks the activity as splittable, and split rows must sum exactly to the required hours.

criteria.description: 对于每个顾问和每个工作周，总计划时间不超过该顾问的净可用能力。
criteria.evidence: 详细的时间表和顾问每周总结。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据活动分配重新计算每周工作时间，包括来源分配此类工作量的审阅者或签字人工作量，并与特定周的能力进行比较。

original.criterion: For every consultant and workweek, total planned hours do not exceed that consultant’s net available capacity from the source.
original.evidence: Detailed schedule and consultant weekly summary.
original.grader_hint: Recompute weekly hours from activity assignments, including reviewer or signatory effort where the source assigns such effort, and compare with the week-specific capacity.

criteria.description: 在源记录不可用期间，不会向顾问分配任何活动、审查或提交职责。
criteria.evidence: 计划周数与顾问可用性记录进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有角色，而不仅仅是负责的所有权；一个人可以在休假期间保留所有权，但不能在不可用的一周内分配工作。

original.criterion: No activity, review, or submission duty is assigned to a consultant during a source-recorded unavailable period.
original.evidence: Scheduled weeks compared with consultant availability records.
original.grader_hint: Check all roles, not only accountable ownership; a person may retain ownership during leave but may not be assigned work in an unavailable week.

criteria.description: 每项预定活动都会分配给一名顾问，该顾问记录的能力满足该活动的每个强制性能力标签。
criteria.evidence: 活动能力要求和顾问能力记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源中的强制标签。一般资历、可用性或客户熟悉度并不能替代缺失的能力。

original.criterion: Each scheduled activity is assigned to a consultant whose recorded competence satisfies every mandatory competence tag for that activity.
original.evidence: Activity competence requirements and consultant competence records.
original.grader_hint: Use the mandatory tags in the source. General seniority, availability, or client familiarity does not substitute for a missing competence.

criteria.description: 每份需要批准的面向客户的监管提交文件都有经过批准的签字人，并且没有未经批准的顾问签署。
criteria.evidence: 提交活动、签名字段和批准记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查截至源生效日期的批准状态。当满足所有监督和签字要求时，非签字人的所有权或起草是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Every client-facing regulatory submission that requires approval has an approved signatory, and no unapproved consultant is shown as signing it.
original.evidence: Submission activities, signatory fields, and approval records.
original.grader_hint: Check approval status as of the source effective date. Ownership or drafting by a non-signatory is acceptable when all supervision and sign-off requirements are met.

criteria.description: 提交的两个主要许可证均获得来源要求的符合纪律的签字人和独立保证范围。
criteria.evidence: 主要许可活动任务和顾问纪律或批准记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证签字人的相关批准范围和所需的独立鉴证作用；单一的签字人指定是不够的。

original.criterion: The two major permit submissions receive the discipline-appropriate signatory and independent assurance coverage required by the source.
original.evidence: Major-permit activity assignments and consultant discipline or approval records.
original.grader_hint: Verify both the signatory’s relevant approval scope and the required independent assurance role; a generic signatory designation is insufficient.

criteria.description: 卡西米尔·奥伊罗 (Casimir Oyelowo) 拥有并完成了可供他使用的合格监督提交机会，所需的批准监督员和所有合格里程碑均在其记录的批准窗口截止日期之前完成。
criteria.evidence: 负责任的所有权、合格的活动链、监督任务和预定日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 应用合格的受监督提交的源定义。仅仅支持提交、拥有不合格的可交付成果或在截止日期后完成它并不满足本项要求。

original.criterion: Casimir Oyelowo owns and completes the qualifying supervised-submission opportunity available to him, with the required approved supervisor and all qualifying milestones completed no later than his recorded approval-window deadline.
original.evidence: Accountable ownership, qualifying activity chain, supervision assignment, and scheduled dates.
original.grader_hint: Apply the source definition of a qualifying supervised submission. Merely supporting a submission, owning a non-qualifying deliverable, or completing it after the deadline does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 两项主要的监管提交活动被安排在不同的工作周内。
criteria.evidence: 两个来源指定的主要提交活动的详细时间表日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较分配的Q3工作周标识符；同一工作周的不同日期不满足分隔规则。

original.criterion: The two major regulatory submission activities are placed in different workweeks.
original.evidence: Detailed schedule dates for the two source-designated major submission activities.
original.grader_hint: Compare the assigned Q3 workweek identifiers; different days in the same workweek do not satisfy the separation rule.

criteria.description: 所有源指定的站点访问和其他互斥的活动对都安排在不同的工作周中。
criteria.evidence: 与排除对记录相比的详细时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试源排除列表中的每一对。无论是否分配不同的顾问，分离都适用。

original.criterion: All source-designated site-access and other mutually exclusive activity pairs are scheduled in different workweeks.
original.evidence: Detailed schedule compared with the exclusion-pair records.
original.grader_hint: Test every pair in the source exclusion list. Separation applies regardless of whether different consultants are assigned.

criteria.description: 每项前置活动都在其后继活动开始之前完成，包括两个主要许可证的完整链条。
criteria.evidence: 与源依赖图相比的预定开始周和结束周。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于每个依赖边，要求先行者在后继者开始之前完成；除非来源明确允许，否则同周放置无效。

original.criterion: Every predecessor activity is completed before its successor begins, including the full chains for both major permits.
original.evidence: Scheduled start and finish weeks compared with the source dependency graph.
original.grader_hint: For each dependency edge, require predecessor finish before successor start; same-week placement is invalid unless the source explicitly permits it.

criteria.description: 每项活动都在其允许的交付窗口内开始和完成，所有作品集工作均在 25 9 月 2026 之前完成。
criteria.evidence: 详细的计划日期、活动窗口和最终完成日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查最早开始和最晚完成边界。可交付水平的日期并不能解决窗口外的基础活动。

original.criterion: Every activity starts and finishes within its permitted delivery window, and all portfolio work is complete by 25 September 2026.
original.evidence: Detailed schedule dates, activity windows, and final completion dates.
original.grader_hint: Check both earliest-start and latest-finish bounds. A deliverable-level date does not cure an out-of-window underlying activity.

criteria.description: 多周和不可分割的活动遵循源持续时间和连续性规则。
criteria.evidence: 活动持续时间属性和计划的周跨度。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求指定的工作周数以及需要连续性的连续安置；不可分割的工作不能分散在行或周之间。

original.criterion: Multiweek and non-splittable activities obey the source duration and continuity rules.
original.evidence: Activity duration attributes and scheduled week spans.
original.grader_hint: Require the specified number of workweeks and consecutive placement where continuity is required; non-splittable work cannot be scattered across rows or weeks.

criteria.description: 如果需要独立审核，审核者不同于为该交付物确定的起草者或准备者。
criteria.evidence: 起草、准备和独立审查作业。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较每个来源指定的独立审查的指定个人；仅签署地位并不能确立独立性。

original.criterion: Where independent review is required, the reviewer is different from the drafter or preparer identified for that deliverable.
original.evidence: Drafting, preparation, and independent-review assignments.
original.grader_hint: Compare named individuals for each source-designated independent review; signatory status alone does not establish independence.

criteria.description: 每个可交付成果报告的所有者和支持分配都与基本计划时间和可交付成果所需的总工作量相一致。
criteria.evidence: 作业登记册、详细时间表和可交付成果摘要。
criteria.grader_hint: 按交付成果和人员重新计算时间。仅允许普通电子表格舍入，显示的百分比在重新计算值的 ±0.1 百分点范围内。

original.criterion: Each deliverable’s reported owner and support allocations reconcile to the underlying scheduled hours and to the deliverable’s total required effort.
original.evidence: Assignment register, detailed schedule, and deliverable summary.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate hours by deliverable and person. Allow only ordinary spreadsheet rounding, with displayed percentages within ±0.1 percentage points of the recalculated values.

criteria.description: 每个顾问的每周和每季度计划时间总数等于该顾问的详细活动、审查、监督和签署任务的总和。
criteria.evidence: 详细的时间表和顾问总结。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据详细记录重新计算总数；每个每周和每季度显示的总数必须在 ±0.1 小时内一致。

original.criterion: Each consultant’s weekly and quarterly planned-hour totals equal the sum of that consultant’s detailed activity, review, supervision, and signatory assignments.
original.evidence: Detailed schedule and consultant summary.
original.grader_hint: Recompute totals from detailed records; each weekly and quarterly displayed total must agree within ±0.1 hour.

criteria.description: 显示的利用率和剩余容量数字是使用源报告定义根据计划小时数和净可用小时数计算得出的。
criteria.evidence: 顾问汇总值和源报告定义。
criteria.grader_hint: 按照源中的定义重新计算利用率。百分比必须在±0.1百分点范围内一致，剩余时间必须在±0.1小时范围内一致。

original.criterion: Displayed utilisation and remaining-capacity figures are calculated from planned hours and net available hours using the source reporting definitions.
original.evidence: Consultant summary values and source reporting definitions.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate utilisation as defined in the source. Percentages must agree within ±0.1 percentage points and remaining hours within ±0.1 hour.

criteria.description: 当评分者更改详细的作业时间、周或签名条目时，汇总总数、利用率和请求的冲突警告会正确更新。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式、验证、条件格式或等效的电子表格自动化。
criteria.grader_hint: 对副本进行测试：更改一项计划工时值、创建一项每周超载、将一项活动移出其窗口以及删除一名所需的签名者。相关摘要和警告状态应更新，无需手动重建。

original.criterion: Summary totals, utilisation, and requested conflict warnings update correctly when a grader changes a detailed assignment hour, week, or signatory entry.
original.evidence: Workbook formulas, validation, conditional formatting, or equivalent spreadsheet automation.
original.grader_hint: Test on a copy: alter one planned-hours value, create one weekly overload, move one activity outside its window, and remove one required signatory. Relevant summaries and warning states should update without manual rebuilding.

criteria.description: 每个负责任所有者的理由都是简洁的，针对该人和可交付成果，并有源证据支持，而不是笼统的资历主张。
criteria.evidence: 所有者理由字段和来源能力、经验、可用性、连续性和开发记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 强有力的理由可以确定相关证据并在需要时承认监督。诸如“最高级”或“最合适”之类的通用陈述，如果没有具体说明，则不会获得满分。

original.criterion: Each accountable-owner rationale is concise, specific to that person and deliverable, and supported by the source evidence rather than a blanket seniority claim.
original.evidence: Owner rationale fields and source competence, experience, availability, continuity, and development records.
original.grader_hint: A strong rationale identifies the relevant evidence and acknowledges supervision where needed. Generic statements such as 'most senior' or 'best fit' without particulars do not earn full credit.

criteria.description: 可疑的所有者选择包括对为什么没有选择另一个看似合理的候选人的可信解释，以及假设日志记录了保守的解释，但没有发明事实。
criteria.evidence: 决策理由和假设或决策记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 重点关注由来源的密切能力或可用性确定的有争议的选择，尤其是主要许可证。解释应该尊重、基于证据，并与最终时间表保持一致。

original.criterion: Questionable owner choices include a credible explanation of why another plausible candidate was not selected, and the assumptions log records conservative interpretations without inventing facts.
original.evidence: Decision rationale and assumptions or decision record.
original.grader_hint: Focus on contested choices identified by close competence or availability in the source, especially the major permits. Explanations should be respectful, evidence-based, and consistent with the final schedule.

criteria.description: 该工作簿可专业用于监督审查：计划条目、日期、分配、警告状态和图例清晰可见，无需剪裁、隐藏关键内容或无法解释的颜色编码。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的工作簿工作表以及打印或导出视图。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染所有填充的视图。检查是否有被截断的标签、不可读的缩放、重叠的对象、隐藏的计划条目、不一致的警告颜色以及与其描述的单元格不匹配的图例。

original.criterion: The workbook is professionally usable for oversight review: scheduled entries, dates, allocations, warning states, and legends are visible and legible without clipping, hidden critical content, or unexplained colour coding.
original.evidence: Rendered workbook sheets and print or export views.
original.grader_hint: Render all populated views. Check for truncated labels, unreadable scaling, overlapping objects, hidden schedule entries, inconsistent warning colours, and legends that do not match the cells they describe.

spec.professional_context: Fenwick Marsh Environmental is allocating a constrained quarterly permitting portfolio across six consultants before client leads are confirmed. The workbook will support Rhiannon Setterfield’s bounded staffing decision and subsequent compliance oversight.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling activity dependencies, delivery windows, competence, leave, and week-specific capacity across a thirteen-week quarter.
Scheduling two long major-permit chains around scarce discipline-specific signatories and same-week exclusion rules.
Meeting Casimir Oyelowo’s bounded supervised-submission development commitment without treating signatory status as an ownership requirement.
Producing live, reconciling spreadsheet summaries and conflict warnings alongside defensible person-specific staffing rationales.

instance.planning_horizon: Thirteen Monday-to-Friday workweeks from 29 June through 25 September 2026.

item_pool_size.activities: Use compact activity chains: six activities for each major permit and two to four for each remaining deliverable.

Marisol Reinholt.competence_profile: Approved client-facing signatory for water, wetlands, and integrated permit submissions; strong Saltcombe continuity.

Ravi Moravec.competence_profile: Approved client-facing signatory for air, waste, and logistics-depot submissions; strong Westmere continuity.

Chidi Jankowski.competence_profile: Ecology, drainage, water evidence, and independent technical review; not an approved submission signatory.

Arjun Redmayne.competence_profile: Air modelling, emissions inventories, noise, and quantitative analysis; not an approved submission signatory.

Lorcan Dimitrov.competence_profile: Waste operations, site audits, permit registers, and operational controls; not an approved submission signatory.

Casimir Oyelowo.competence_profile: Water and wetlands permitting, drafting, and client preparation; not yet an approved signatory.
Casimir Oyelowo.development_commitment: Must own and complete one qualifying supervised major submission by the end of W08. Only the water or wetlands major permit is competence-eligible for him.

content_requirements: Include nine synthetic deliverables split between Saltcombe Provisions and Westmere Logistics, with stable deliverable IDs.
Designate one Saltcombe water or wetlands variation and one Westmere air variation as the two major permits.

Give each activity a stable ID, deliverable link, required effort, required competence tags, earliest week, latest week, duration, split or continuity status, predecessor links, and any required role such as drafter, independent reviewer, supervisor, or signatory.
Provide week-specific net capacity and unavailability for all six consultants, plus competence, client continuity, signatory scope, and relevant development evidence.

Include an England permitting control note effective 15 May 2026 stating which activities require client-facing sign-off, discipline-appropriate approval, independent review, and supervised-submission evidence.

Carry the local meanings of accountable owner, support allocation, planned hours, available hours, utilisation, remaining capacity, major submission, qualifying supervised submission, and independent review.
Include reporting vocabulary sufficient for the solver to identify the required assignment, schedule, summary, warning, rationale, and assumptions fields without guessing local codes.

deliverable_structure.D1: Saltcombe major water or wetlands permit variation. Six-stage chain: scope, site evidence, technical assessment, draft, independent assurance, client submission. Earliest W02, completion no later than W08. This is the only qualifying major permit matching Casimir Oyelowo's competence, so the development rule makes him accountable owner in every feasible solution. Marisol Reinholt is the discipline-appropriate supervisor and signatory.
deliverable_structure.D2: Westmere major air permit variation. Six-stage chain: scope, site test, model, draft, independent assurance, client submission. Earliest W03, completion no later than W11. Ravi Moravec is the discipline-appropriate signatory; Arjun Redmayne is a strong non-signatory owner or technical-lead candidate.
deliverable_structure.D3_to_D9: Use seven smaller but material deliverables covering ecology screening, waste controls, noise, drainage, solvent inventory, trade-effluent pre-application, and a quarterly permit register. Give each a two-to-four-stage chain, a bounded window, competence requirements, and enough effort to make weekly capacity consequential.

hard_constraints: Each deliverable has exactly one accountable owner from the six-person roster.
Each activity is scheduled exactly once and receives its full required effort; non-splittable work remains intact and continuity-designated work occupies consecutive weeks.
All activity competence tags must be held by the assigned person.
For every person-week, activity, reviewer, supervision, and signatory hours together must not exceed the source net capacity; no effort may be assigned during zero-capacity leave.
Every dependency edge requires predecessor completion before successor start.
Every activity stays within its earliest-start and latest-finish window, and all work finishes by 25 September 2026.
Only Marisol Reinholt and Ravi Moravec may sign client-facing submissions, and only within their recorded discipline scopes.
Major permits require an approved discipline-appropriate signatory and an independent reviewer different from the drafter.
Casimir Oyelowo must own D1 and complete its supervised client-facing submission by the end of W08 under Marisol Reinholt; supporting someone else's submission does not count.
The D1 and D2 major submission activities may not occur in the same workweek.

Create at least two additional source-visible exclusion pairs tied to shared site access: the D1 site-evidence activity versus a Saltcombe ecology walkover, and the D2 site-test activity versus a Westmere waste audit. Each pair must occupy different workweeks regardless of assignee.
The accountable owner performs the source-designated ownership milestones, while specialist analysis, independent review, and signatory work may be allocated to eligible support personnel.
Owner and support allocations equal the underlying scheduled hours; all person, deliverable, week, and quarter summaries reconcile.

contention_and_tightness.target_tightness: Approximately 0.70, with a feasible solution but little slack on both major-permit chains.
contention_and_tightness.critical_path: D1 spans W02-W08 with six ordered stages and no more than one week of total slack; D2 spans W03-W11 with six ordered stages and limited slack. Submission separation and site-access exclusions should remove the obvious earliest-start placement.
contention_and_tightness.scarce_resources: Only Marisol Reinholt and Ravi Moravec can sign. Their discipline scopes prevent simple interchangeability, and their reduced-capacity or leave weeks must affect feasible placement.
contention_and_tightness.capacity_pressure: Tune activity effort so at least four consultant-weeks in a reference solution are at or above 90% utilisation and moving either major submission to the most obvious alternate week causes a capacity, leave, or exclusion conflict.
contention_and_tightness.anti_greedy_requirement: An earliest-start assignment with each deliverable given to the most senior eligible consultant must fail at least the Casimir development requirement and one weekly capacity or same-week exclusion constraint.

soft_preferences.preference: Use recorded client continuity where it does not defeat competence, capacity, independence, or the Casimir development commitment.
Avoid unnecessary fragmentation of support work across consultants.
Keep utilisation balanced enough that avoidable overload warnings are not created.

intended_verdict.gold_form: Constraint checker plus at least one solver-generated feasible workbook population.
intended_verdict.validation: Run a CP-SAT or mixed-integer solver over owner, activity-week, assignee, reviewer, supervisor, and signatory variables. Confirm every hard constraint is satisfiable, record binding constraints and utilisation, then verify that the reference workbook population satisfies every rubric predicate and workbook-behaviour test.

reference_files.discovery: Review the full workbook, including the operational records, policy material, and reporting conventions, before assigning owners or scheduling activities.

deliverables.description: A regulator-ready Q3 resource and workload distribution tracker covering accountable ownership, activity scheduling, weekly allocations, capacity, submission controls, selection rationale, and decision assumptions.
constraints: Must be created at the top level of the working directory using exactly q3_workload_tracker.xlsx.
Must cover all nine supplied deliverables and all supplied activities through the quarter ending 25 September 2026.
Must include an assignment register, an activity-level weekly schedule, consultant and deliverable summaries, and an assumptions and decision record.
Summary calculations and warning states must remain live and auditable in the workbook.
Detailed records must be filterable, and all visible content must remain legible when reviewed on screen or exported.

original_instruction:
You are the project management specialist coordinating Fenwick Marsh Environmental’s Q3 2026 permitting portfolio for Rhiannon Setterfield. Rhiannon has to confirm client leads with Saltcombe Provisions and Westmere Logistics by Friday, 26 June 2026, and she needs a staffed quarter rather than another provisional capacity list. The attached `q3_permitting_workload.xlsx` contains the nine deliverables, activity effort, dependencies, delivery windows, consultant availability, competence and approval records, development commitments, and the England permitting control note that applies as at 15 May 2026. It also carries the reporting terms used by the portfolio team. Treat the listed weekly capacity as the time remaining after other committed work; we are not adding people or moving work outside the quarter. Prepare `q3_workload_tracker.xlsx` and write it into the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename. The workbook needs to let Rhiannon and a compliance reviewer establish the following without reconstructing your reasoning: (1) give every deliverable one accountable owner, identify any supporting consultant and approved submission signatory where applicable, and show the allocation of each person’s available time by deliverable and week; (2) schedule every listed activity within the Q3 workweeks, respecting its delivery window, duration, dependencies, competence requirements, unavailable periods, and any activities that cannot share a week, with the final portfolio complete by Friday, 25 September 2026; (3) apply the client-facing submission and independent-review controls in the source, including the limits on who may sign, but do not treat signatory status as a blanket rule for who can own the underlying work; (4) deal explicitly with Casimir Oyelowo’s supervised-submission approval window while keeping the resulting plan feasible and properly supervised; (5) include a consultant summary showing weekly planned hours, available hours, utilisation percentage, remaining capacity or overload, and quarter totals, plus a deliverable summary that reconciles to the detailed schedule; (6) give a concise, person-specific reason for each accountable-owner choice, grounded in the competence, relevant experience, availability, client continuity, or documented development evidence in the source, and briefly record why another plausible candidate was not selected where the choice could reasonably be questioned; and (7) include a short assumptions and decision log for any conservative interpretation you make, without inventing approvals, competencies, extra capacity, or changes to the England control note. Keep calculations live rather than typing summary totals, make the detailed schedule filterable, and provide visible warnings for overloads, unmet dependencies, missing signatory coverage, work outside its allowed window, or the prohibited same-week combinations. The final workbook should contain a clear assignment register, an activity-level weekly schedule, consultant and deliverable summaries, and the assumptions and decision record. It will be read on screen and exported for the quarterly oversight pack, so labels, dates, percentages, legends, and warning states must remain legible and unambiguous without relying on hidden cells or undocumented colour meanings.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/q3_permitting_workload.xlsx` — Provides the nine Q3 permitting deliverables, activity effort and dependencies, delivery windows, consultant capacities and availability, competence and signatory records, development commitments, mutually exclusive activity rules, the applicable England control note as at 15 May 2026, and Fenwick Marsh reporting terminology.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `q3_workload_tracker.xlsx` — A regulator-ready Q3 resource and workload distribution tracker covering accountable ownership, activity scheduling, weekly allocations, capacity, submission controls, selection rationale, and decision assumptions. (Must be created at the top level of the working directory using exactly q3_workload_tracker.xlsx.; Must cover all nine supplied deliverables and all supplied activities through the quarter ending 25 September 2026.; Must include an assignment register, an activity-level weekly schedule, consultant and deliverable summaries, and an assumptions and decision record.; Summary calculations and warning states must remain live and auditable in the workbook.; Detailed records must be filterable, and all visible content must remain legible when reviewed on screen or exported.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
